brief:
At least five Palestinians were killed in Israeli operations across Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. One Palestinian died and another was wounded when Israeli drones struck a vehicle in Rafah in the southern Gaza Strip, according to ambulance and emergency service sources cited by Al Jazeera.

The incidents occurred as tensions remain high in the territory following months of conflict.
dek: Five Palestinians killed by Israel in Gaza At least one Palestinian has been killed and another wounded after Israeli drones struck a vehicle in Rafah, in the southern Gaza Strip, Al Jazeera reported, citing ambulance and emergency service sources.
title: Israeli strikes kill five Palestinians in Gaza
